name: Laguna Fabrics
old_description: Since 2000, Laguna has been making fabric with raw materials that have a lower environmental impact than conventional materials and today we are doing even more.
about:
Laguna Fabrics was founded in 1986 in Los Angeles, California, by Monet Goode and has been operated by the Roshan family across multiple generations. The family-owned company began as a circular knit mill serving the contemporary fashion market.

The company produces sustainable circular knit fabrics using in-house knitting machines ranging from low to fine gauge, with a capacity of 1.5 million pounds per month. Its 40-person team handles fabric development, technical analysis, new construction engineering, and sample yardage production. Special finishes include brushing, sueding, and fabric laundering, supported by a multi-layer quality control protocol and an on-site knitting technician.

Laguna serves contemporary fashion brands, young designers, and start-ups seeking sustainable domestic textiles. Longtime clients rely on the mill's quick turnaround and in-stock natural fiber yarns such as GOTS-certified organic cotton, TENCEL™ lyocell and modal, recycled cotton, and hemp.

Since 2000, Laguna has prioritized lower-impact materials, and in 2019 became the only circular knit mill in the United States with GOTS certification. The company's stated goal is to reach 90% sustainable material output by 2025, guided by core values of provenance, process transparency, and product authenticity.
